query: Please implement a Forex trading platform that provides real-time currency exchange rates and trading functionalities. The platform should support various user roles, including traders, administrators, and support staff. Traders should be able to use a manual trading interface, automated trading options, and copy trading functionality to conduct trades. Administrators should be able to manage users and transaction records, while support staff should be able to provide assistance and resolve issues. Choose sky blue for global background and navy for all components.
